validator: independent DATAML validator (comprev-evidence-validator), sampled API verification (id a20f101459243b50d) + coordinator deterministic local checks

integrity_verification.method: Sampled (22 findings/cluster = 176 total) because exhaustive resolution of 1,339 DOIs is not feasible in a single agent under rate limits. Documented adaptation.

SOURCE_PROVENANCE.note: 1 benign paraphrase against a real on-topic DOI; 3 other initial misses were JATS typography artifacts (verbatim-present).

DOI_TITLE_CROSSCHECK.note: All 8 manually confirmed real on-topic papers; heuristic false-positives from findings lacking a title field.

documented_exits.PAPER_COUNT_FLOOR: All 8 clusters 170-199 unique DOIs, below the 200/cluster floor. Clusters 05 (virtual controls) and 06 (NAMs) showed genuine saturation signals; others were ~1 frame short when the search was closed out.
documented_exits.FULLTEXT_RATE_OVERALL: 24.9% (< 50% target). Much of the preclinical/toxicology/governance literature is paywalled; OA-priority frames lifted per-cluster rates but 50% overall was not achievable without excluding paywalled landmark papers.

user_signoff.prompt: Evidence at 1,339 unique real papers (>1000 floor met); all 8 clusters at 85-99.5% of the 200 target; account usage limit hit 4x. Accept corpus & proceed vs. push all clusters to strict >=200.
user_signoff.note: User accepted the 1,339-unique corpus as the documented saturation/near-target exit. PAPER_COUNT_FLOOR and FULLTEXT_RATE exits are accepted under this sign-off. Verdict is PASS_WITH_DOCUMENTED_EXITS, not a silent flip of a hard-floor FAIL (the 1000 hard floor genuinely passes).
